name: Share Personal Spell (Metamagic)
body:
You have learned to modify spells that normally only affect yourself so that you can cast them on others.

Benefit: A shared spell has a range of touch. Spells with a range other than personal are not affected. A shared spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
